repositories.description: Replaces the PS5 Store tile with WK Store: open the tile, start the jailbreak, and Elf Launcher opens when it finishes. Two chains from the tile: Wobkot (new in 1.2.4; listed offsets: 6.00/6.02, 7.00/7.01/7.20/7.40/7.60, 8.00/8.20/8.40/8.60, 9.00/9.20/9.40/9.60, 10.00/10.20/10.60, 11.00/11.40/11.60, 12.00/12.20/12.40/12.60, 13.00/13.20/13.40/13.60) and Relapse (7.00–13.60). Wobkot is about 0.6s on a good run. Bundles Elf Launcher 2.1.6 and works offline after installation. Needs elfldr on port 9021. If WK Store is already installed, send Restore first and reopen elfldr before installing again; the console reboots itself after install.

repositories.author: mpereiraesaa

repositories.name: PS5 Bazzite Deck
repositories.description: Bazzite (SteamOS-style Linux) image for the PS5 with Steam Gaming Mode and a KDE desktop, shipped as a single bootc image that updates in place with 'sudo bootc upgrade'. Runs from a USB drive or the M.2 slot and leaves the PS5 system untouched; start it with the project's bazzite-bootc-loader ELF, which is based on the ps5-linux-loader project. Use the release marked Latest (pre-releases are test builds); install prerequisites and per-model limitations are on wiki.ps5-linux.eu.
repositories.author: VivaLaVent

repositories.name: EglantinePS5 NUP
repositories.description: Experimental Nintendo Switch 1 and Switch 2 emulator for jailbroken PS5, built on the Eglantine (Eden) core with NUP support so games, updates and DLC run from folders or single .nup files. Reports console testing on firmware 13.60 launched with ShadowMountPlus, with other users on 11.40 and 11.60. Distributed as a ZIP package, not a direct ELF; no games, keys or firmware are included.
repositories.author: viejunerd

repositories.name: Hookshot PS5
repositories.description: Native PS5 port of Hookshot, the static recompilation of the Nintendo Switch 2 version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, running as title PPSA99024 on Mesa RADV from the author's PS5_Vulkan and PS5_PayloadSDK projects. Built on a Linux PC (or WSL 2) from your own game dump at program 0400486024DEC000 with update v131072; the only release is a beta that ships build scripts, not a ready-made title, and no game files or keys are included. The author reports a first boot on a PS5 Pro at 33-40 fps in Kokiri Forest, while Hyrule Castle Town can still run out of memory.
repositories.author: mihawk-99

repositories.name: Kraken Mount
repositories.description: Experimental PS5 ELF payload that registers games from debug FPKG .pkg files or game folders (plain, zstd or LZ4 packs) without installing them, adds a home-screen tile per title and launches it through a bundled ampr-emu-ng runtime. Scans the internal SSD plus USB and extended drives, caches games on internal storage and serves a web UI on port 8097; elfldr must be running. The author reports only a small number of games tested so far and that .pkg support is the newest and least tested path.
repositories.author: quer3q

repositories.name: Kite Pack
repositories.description: Desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that packs your own PS5 game dumps with zstd into folder, exFAT, .ffpkg or .ffpfs copies and sends them over Wi-Fi to a jailbroken PS5; this release asset is the PS5-side kite-helper.elf, which needs an ELF loader (port 9021) and ShadowMount+ watching the destination folder (/data/homebrew by default). Packing uses PS5 Dump Forge and transfers use AVA1; builds are unsigned, DLC installation is not included yet, and it does not include or download games.
repositories.author: nankhor

repositories.name: TITAN CORE
repositories.description: PS5 game workspace with native FPKG engine, external-drive installer and live diagnostics. Bundles kstuff-lite and ShadowMountPlus; starts them automatically. Requires a jailbroken PS5 with elfldr. Dashboard, library, USB browser, cache builder and 31 language/localization support. Arabic RTL, themes, controller-friendly navigation.
repositories.author: devchmod

repositories.name: fuse-ppkg
repositories.description: Mount a PS5 debug FPKG (.pkg) as a read-only directory on Linux. Nothing is unpacked: file bytes are read at their offsets in the .pkg and Kraken blocks are decoded only where a read touches them, through ps5-dump-forge's FpkgSource. Read-only, debug FPKG only, Linux only. Prototype — see upstream Limits before using.
repositories.author: Pix13

repositories.name: BrowserPS5
repositories.description: Full native PS5 web browser (title PPSA97024) with its own WebKit 627.1.7 port, JavaScript JIT, GPU rendering and DualSense controls. The one-file installer ELF installs the browser; its interface runs as a payload that needs an ELF loader on port 9021 (etaHEN starts one) and ShadowMountPlus running every time the browser opens. Tested on one PS5 on firmware 13.60 only. No DRM video (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, Spotify web player), no WebRTC calls/camera/microphone, up to 6 tabs sharing 1 GiB. Release v1.0.0-rc13 is a prerelease that fixes a missing temp folder that made rc12 close at startup.
repositories.author: ramalhoboss

repositories.name: BananaNative
repositories.description: Unofficial, experimental Android compatibility layer for running user-owned Switch 2 game dumps on Snapdragon phones; runs the game's ARM64 code with system-service shims and Vulkan graphics translation. Requires Android 13+, an Adreno GPU and at least 12 GB RAM. Distributed as APKs from its Forgejo releases, not as PS5 payloads.
repositories.author: moceure

repositories.name: green-nx
repositories.description: Unofficial, open-source Xbox Cloud Gaming (xCloud) client for Nintendo Switch homebrew: device-code Microsoft sign-in, a searchable Game Pass library with box art, and native WebRTC streaming at 720p/1080p/1080p HQ with hardware H.264 decoding and zero-copy GPU rendering, plus ad-supported free-to-play titles. Requires Atmosphere CFW, 5 GHz Wi-Fi and a Game Pass subscription for the subscription catalog (games you own and ad-supported free-to-play titles work without one); must be launched in title mode because applet mode lacks memory for hardware decoding. Latest stable release v1.0.30 ships green-nx.nro; a newer v1.0.31pre1 is a prerelease with hardware-tested sign-in and streaming fixes. Nintendo Switch homebrew, not a PS5 payload.
repositories.author: rmrf404

repositories.name: Sphaira
repositories.description: Homebrew menu and file manager for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2. Stable 1.1.0 adds Switch 2 support under kaiHEN; installing, forwarders, game library, game-card, App Store, Themezer, IRS, USB and MTP features are unavailable on Switch 2. Other features include FTP, MTP, file associations for emulator ROM loading, themes, and Ownfoil library installation on Switch. Release is a ZIP, not a PS5 ELF payload.
repositories.author: NaGaa95

repositories.name: WiiCompiled-Switch2
repositories.description: Experimental, unofficial Switch 2 port of WiiCompiled with Retro Rewind, started as an .nro from hbmenu under kaiHEN. Requires your own clean Mario Kart Wii PAL (RMCP01) disc and Retro Rewind files; all releases are prereleases with no downloadable assets, so no game data or built NRO is provided and you build it locally. Author-tested on kaiHEN 20261114d and 20261116 with known issues including 15-20 second shader setup on each launch, no second launch in the same kaiHEN session, and raised clocks only applying on a charger. Not a PS5 payload.
repositories.author: 6rimson

repositories.name: Dekopon
repositories.description: Open-source 3DS emulator for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 based on Azahar (base Azahar 2126.1.1), with gyro, CIA installation, LayeredFS, texture packs, button remapping and multiple screen layouts. Stable v0.9.1 ships dekopon.nro with experimental async shader compilation enabled by default; known issues include lens-flare slowdown in Majora's Mask 3D and slow shader-cache rebuilds on first launch after updating. This is a Switch homebrew NRO, not a PS5 ELF payload.
repositories.author: Olmectron

repositories.name: NxNow
repositories.description: Unofficial native GeForce NOW client for Nintendo Switch homebrew, with a controller-first library and catalog UI, QR-code NVIDIA sign-in, a Switch virtual keyboard and mouse mode, 30/60 FPS stream profiles, server, codec and bitrate settings, and an optional performance HUD. Requires a GeForce NOW account and game entitlements, hbmenu in application mode (hold R while launching an installed game), and a stable 5 GHz Wi-Fi connection. Early stable release v0.2.4 ships NxNow.nro; this is a Switch homebrew client, not a PS5 payload.
repositories.author: kazar-root

repositories.name: OpenNOW-Switch
repositories.description: Native, controller-first GeForce NOW client for Nintendo Switch homebrew, derived from SwitchNOW. Includes library and store browsing, cloud-session launching, native WebRTC with H.264/Opus, NVDEC hardware decoding with a software fallback, and a HOME shortcut installer. Requires custom firmware, hbmenu and a valid GeForce NOW account; the author recommends overclocking because stock clocks give about 45-50 FPS instead of a steady 60. Stable v0.0.12 ships SwitchNOW-0.0.12.nro; this is a Switch homebrew client, not a PS5 payload.
repositories.author: OpenCloudGaming

repositories.name: brewstore
repositories.description: Homebrew storefront for Nintendo Switch 2 under kaiHEN, with in-app catalog refresh and support for custom repositories hosted as packages.json manifests. Installation replaces hbmenu.nro with a modified build and places brewloader.nro in the kaiHEN programs directory; version string should read v1337.69420.l33t. Stable 1.2.0 ships brewstore.nro; this is a Switch homebrew NRO, not a PS5 ELF payload.
repositories.author: HerXayah

repositories.name: blacklist-tool
repositories.description: Switch 2 homebrew for viewing and modifying the console's FunctionBlackList, which can show blocked games, unblock titles with mandatory updates so owned copies can be played without updating, or install a custom blacklist. Changes persist across reboots and possibly factory resets; writing the BCAT copy may risk a console ban. Stable v1.1.0 ships blacklist-tool-switch2.nro; this is a Switch homebrew NRO, not a PS5 ELF payload.
repositories.author: s8n

repositories.name: PPSSPP-NX2
repositories.description: Experimental native PSP emulator port for Nintendo Switch 2 under kaiHEN, forked from PPSSPP and built with libounce/OunceVK (Vulkan) and the ARM64 recompiler. Requires ounce-devkit, libkaihen with kaihenJitPublishRanges (protocol 6 or compatible) and a GameShare-capable title-override launch; applet mode is not qualified. Release v0.1.0 ships PPSSPP-NX2.nro with an experimental GameShare guest mode; upstream reports console-tested menu, controls and Tekken gameplay with JIT and audio, but sustained speed remains unqualified, touch/rumble/camera/microphone/HTTPS are not implemented, and no PSP games or firmware are included. This is a Switch homebrew NRO, not a PS5 ELF payload.
repositories.author: XITRIX

repositories.name: Luac0re
repositories.description: Archived research project and mast1c0re variant for PS4 and PS5 that uses the console's embedded Lua 5.3 interpreter to simplify PS2-emulator exploit development instead of PS2SDK shellcode. From version 2.0 it adds a JIT compiler exploit which upstream reports enables arbitrary native userland code execution on current PS4/PS5 firmware without a kernel exploit and bypasses the PS5 8.00+ non-AF_UNIX socket restriction; the poopsploit path still requires PS5 12.00 or lower. Requires a legally owned copy of Star Wars Racer Revenge (CUSA03474/CUSA03492) and mandatory resigning of the included savedata image. Stable 2.4b is a ZIP package, not a direct ELF payload.
repositories.author: Gezine
